about.description: Single-stock perpetual on RISEx tracking Circle Internet Group, Inc. (NYSE: CRCL), cash-settled and margined in USDC, up to 10x leverage. RISEx is a fully onchain orderbook perp DEX on RISE Chain, where the orderbook shares state with DeFi protocols in the same block. Index price from Stork (median CEX spot); mark price is the median of an index-anchored premium, the raw book signal and a Stork anchor. Trades 24/7 including nights, weekends and holidays when the underlying market is closed, so liquidity thins during off-hours.
